l1_words.meaning: university degree or course of study (also: race)

pattern_explanation: Spanish and English share Latin roots, so many words look alike. Some of these look-alike forms have shifted meanings, so the similar spelling points to a different word.
false_friend_warning: Careful: the Spanish word carrera looks like the English word career, but it usually means a university degree or course of study, not a profession. Also, the Spanish word actual means current or present, not actual in the English sense.
